abilities.label: BATTLECRY
abilities.span: Battlecry: Your opponent's spells cost (1) more next turn.

dependencies.detail: HAND-only application leaves the cost of spells in DECK unresolved when an additional effect reads deck costs.
dependencies.source_needed: Independent rule evidence or a discriminating observed game; pinned metadata for IDs

decisions.question: Who is taxed and for which turn?
alternatives: Every enemy spell during next enemy turn
Only next spell or current turn
decisions.chosen: Every enemy spell during next enemy turn
decisions.discriminating_case: Two enemy spells next turn are both taxed; no tax remains the following turn.

decisions.question: Are deck spell costs also modified?
decisions.discriminating_case: During the taxed turn an effect reads a spell's cost while it is still in the opponent's deck.
